comment: Constants and per-archetype recipes of the building band planner (S2_ROOMS_PLAN.md sections 3.1, 3.3, 3.4, 3.8; designer decision 8.1: minimum room 4 x 4 m). Read by Tools/TrainingGround/src/levelgen/buildings/bandPlan.ts. All lengths are integer cm in the planner's own frame (u along the long side, v across, v = 0 on the core wall). core.corridor_max_cm is a planner knob, not a plan constant: the widest the corridor may get beside the core in a double-loaded bay (it starts at the core depth and ends on the corridor line shared with the neighbouring bays).

office.bay_grammar: core room* (end | exit) | room* core room*

block.comment: S2.3 block (S2_ROOMS_PLAN.md 3.3 / 3.4): sections `flat core flat` (section_cm) or, under one section's minimum, `core flat` (the flat takes flat_bay_cm: L = 900 + flat); a landing (corridor cell) over the core bay at v = core depth .. landing_top (A / B boundary, one line for the whole building); per flat a back room A (depth = landing_top), a front room B (the rest) and the nearer front room C of the core bay (the core bay's front is split in two rooms of room_cm); the flat of one side per section gets a second entry through C (the section's loop), the other flat is a dead end. A long block is several sections side by side, a wall without doors between them (they meet on the roof). Per-storey slot windows (balcony / fire escape of story 4) sit in the B room of every flat from slot_min_storey up; designer 2026-11-19: no balcony without a fire escape, so no base balconies are generated.

block_kit.comment: Kit pattern of the residential block (docs/design/levelgen/BGEN_KIT_PLANS_2026-11-21.md; measured from the Soviet panel-block pack: KIT_PILOT_2026-11-20.md, Saved/KitDump). Used when recipes.block.pattern is 'kit'; a footprint it cannot cut falls back to the S2.3 sections planner (recipes.block), then to the BSP. Plan frame as everywhere: u along the facade, v across, v = 0 = the court wall. A section = [flat A | tambour T | core K | flat C] along u; K (core.width_cm x core.depth_cm) and T (tambour_cm x core.depth_cm) stand on the court wall, flat B takes the street band over T + K (v = core depth .. D), A and C run the full depth. The core is a half-landing switchback: the floor landing (landing_cm) on the court side - the ground storey's court door opens onto it -, two flights per storey (each half the storey rise, 35 deg run) in two lanes, the mid landing (mid_landing_cm) at the far (inner) end; flats are entered from the landing (C) and from the tambour (A, B). A section under three_flat_min_depth_cm deep (the street band too shallow for flat B) is a two-flat section [A | K | C] (A and C full depth, both entered from the landing). Rooms on the 50 cm grid (designer 2026-11-20); every door keeps today's 150 cm (a door needs a 200 cm wall, so baths are 200 deep - the kit's 80 cm doors would allow 3 m2 baths: open question). Windows keep window_clear_cm (50, the kit's window grid in 3 m bays) from partitions and corners instead of the office's 120, so a 300 cm kitchen gets its window (the full window pass is a later step). Room areas: hall ~5-9, bath ~5-11, kitchen ~6-14, living ~9-35 m2 (room_area_m2 = the tolerance the TS tests check).
